blocks.text: 虽然沙箱本身已是大宗商品，但在生产级流量下服务数百万个沙箱，需要大量细节才能为企业和消费者扩展智能体。我们开源了支撑整个 Perplexity Computer 的沙箱平台 SPACE，以支持生态系统。https://github.com/perplexityai/space

blocks.text: While sandboxes are a commodity, serving millions of them under production-grade traffic requires a lot of detail to scale agents for businesses and consumers. We're open-sourcing the sandbox platform SPACE that powers all of Perplexity Computer to support the ecosystem. https://github.com/perplexityai/space
